notes: Cliopatria has no Ndwandwe row; the sibling zululand dossier already names ndwandwe-kingdom as counterpart for its 1820 gain, so this slug is kept. Two pages: Ndwandwe (the title Ndwandwe_Kingdom did not load: URL_NOT_FOUND) and Dingiswayo for context. The page gives no area, no capital, no coordinates and no Pedi or Nxaba (it lists 'Langa KaXaba' as the pre-1805 ruler). End year: 1820 (defeat at Mhlatuze, land passes to the Zulu) against the infobox's 1825. The box limits are the researcher's own estimate of the two river lines; the gazetteer has a Pongola river but no Black Umfolozi.
